It is unknown as to whether the '''Matukai meditation band''' was created by beings affiliated with the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] or simply named after them. When worn, this band provided greater protection from the influences of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] than the standard [[meditation band]].
